chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Do not sit sideways on riding animals, and do not make their backs your seats."

key_terms.الدَّوَابِّ: Riding animals or beasts used for transport
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَا تَتَوَرَّكُوا: Do not sit in a sideways or burdensome manner

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about the proper treatment of riding animals?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to treat animals with consideration and not use them in a harmful or inconsiderate manner. It reflects the Prophetic concern for the rights of animals and proper conduct toward creatures under human control.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2471 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"Do not sit sideways on animals, and do not make their backs your seats."
